# SQL Patterns: mp_order.dwd_order_item_all_ent_df__reg_s0_live

## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 基础分区过滤（几乎所有查询）
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_date >= date_sub('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', N)  -- N = 6/13/27/30/90
  AND grass_date <= date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND is_bi_excluded = 0

-- 按创建日期过滤（配合分区裁剪）
  AND date(create_datetime) = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
  AND date(create_datetime) >= date_sub('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', N)

-- 有效订单过滤
  AND gmv > 0  -- 或 gmv_usd != 0
  AND coalesce(is_returned_item, 0) = 0
  AND coalesce(cancelled_qty, 0) = 0
  AND order_be_status_id != 1

-- 已完成/已评价订单
  AND order_item_status IN ('OITEM_UNRATED', 'OITEM_RATED')

-- 多区域过滤
  AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'SG', 'TH', 'PH', 'TW', 'MY', 'VN', 'BR')

-- 跨境店铺过滤
  AND is_cb_shop = 1

-- 净订单
  AND is_net_order = 1

-- 无券自然单
  AND pv_promotion_id IS NULL
  AND sv_promotion_id IS NULL

-- 排除 CB Citi 支付渠道（用于净收入计算）
  AND COALESCE(payment_be_channel_id, 0) NOT IN (100061, 100062, 100064, 100065, 100066, 100067, 100068, 100069, 100070, 100071, 100072, 100073, 100074, 100075, 100076, 100077, 100078, 100079, 100080, 101420)
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- JOIN dim_advertiser (获取卖家类型、CB 标记)
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_advertiser__reg_s0_live
  ON a.shop_id = b.shop_id
 WHERE b.grass_date = '${grass_date}'
   AND b.grass_region = upper('${grass_region}')
   AND b.tz_type = 'local'

-- JOIN dim_exchange_rate (本币转 USD)
LEFT JOIN mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live
  ON a.grass_date = b.grass_date
 AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region

-- JOIN dim_shop_ext (店铺扩展信息：SIP 关联、CB 来源地)
LEFT JOIN mp_seller.dim_shop_ext__reg_s0_live
  ON a.shop_id = b.shop_id
 WHERE b.grass_date = '${grass_date}'
   AND b.grass_region = upper('${grass_region}')
   AND b.tz_type = 'local'

-- JOIN dim_item (商品详情)
LEFT JOIN mp_item.dim_item__reg_s0_live
  ON a.item_id = b.item_id
 WHERE b.grass_date = DATE('...')
   AND b.grass_region = '...'

-- SELF JOIN (全局先验概率，用于贝叶斯平滑)
JOIN global_prior g ON u.grass_region = g.grass_region
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- GMV 滚动窗口聚合（by shop_id）
SELECT shop_id
     , SUM(CASE WHEN date(create_datetime) = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}') AND is_bi_excluded = 0 THEN gmv END) AS gmv_1d
     , SUM(CASE WHEN date(create_datetime) >= date('${PREV_7D}') AND is_bi_excluded = 0 THEN gmv END) AS gmv_7d
     , SUM(CASE WHEN date(create_datetime) >= date('${PREV_14D}') AND is_bi_excluded = 0 THEN gmv END) AS gmv_14d
     , SUM(CASE WHEN is_bi_excluded = 0 THEN gmv END) AS gmv_30d
FROM mp_order.dwd_order_item_all_ent_df__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_date >= date('${PREV_30D}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND is_bi_excluded = 0
  AND gmv > 0
GROUP BY shop_id

-- Escrow 有效 GMV（已完成订单）
     , SUM(CASE WHEN complete_datetime IS NOT NULL
                AND order_item_status IN ('OITEM_UNRATED','OITEM_RATED')
                THEN seller_gmv END) AS escrow_based_seller_gmv

-- 佣金聚合（by item_id, shop_id, region）
SELECT item_id, shop_id
     , SUM(IF(local_create_date = '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', commission_base_amt_usd, 0)) AS commission_base_amt_usd_1d
     , SUM(IF(local_create_date >= date_sub('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', 6), commission_base_amt_usd, 0)) AS commission_base_amt_usd_7d
FROM order_raw
GROUP BY item_id, shop_id, grass_region

-- 订单数统计（去重）
     , COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt

-- 时间桶计算（本地时区 offset）
     -- SG/TW/PH/MY: +8h, TH/VN/ID: +7h, BR: -3h
     (create_timestamp + <region_offset> * 3600) / 60 % 1440 AS min_bucket

-- 无券自然单比例（贝叶斯平滑）
     (SUM(CASE WHEN pv_promotion_id IS NULL AND sv_promotion_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + global_mu * 10.0)
   / (COUNT(1) + 10.0) AS ratio_u
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. Shop Take Rate GMV 聚合 (dws_shop_take_rate_nd)

```sql
SELECT shop_id
     , SUM(CASE WHEN date(create_datetime) = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}') AND is_bi_excluded = 0 THEN seller_gmv END) AS platform_seller_gmv_amt_1d
     , SUM(CASE WHEN date(create_datetime) = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}') AND is_bi_excluded = 0 THEN gmv END) AS platform_gmv_amt_1d
     , SUM(CASE WHEN date(create_datetime) = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}') AND complete_datetime IS NOT NULL
                AND order_item_status IN ('OITEM_UNRATED','OITEM_RATED') THEN seller_gmv END) AS escrow_based_seller_gmv_amt_1d
FROM mp_order.dwd_order_item_all_ent_df__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_date >= date('${PREV_30D}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND date(create_datetime) >= date('${PREV_30D}')
  AND date(create_datetime) < date_add(date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'), 1)
  AND gmv > 0
GROUP BY shop_id
```

### 2. CB Citi 支付渠道比例 (dws_advertise_net_ads_revenue_1d)

```sql
SELECT substr(create_datetime, 1, 10) AS create_date
     , SUM(IF(COALESCE(payment_be_channel_id, 0) NOT IN (100061, 100062, ..., 101420), gmv_usd, 0))
     / SUM(gmv_usd) AS cb_citi_ratio
FROM mp_order.dwd_order_item_all_ent_df__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date >= date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${grass_region}')
  AND date(create_datetime) = date('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND is_bi_excluded = 0
  AND order_be_status_id != 1
  AND is_net_order = 1
  AND is_cb_shop = 1
  AND gmv_usd != 0
GROUP BY 1
```

### 3. 订单 escrow 金额聚合 (dwd_order_escrow_di)

```sql
SELECT order_id
     , SUM(seller_gmv) AS seller_gmv
     , SUM(seller_gmv_usd) AS seller_gmv_usd
     , SUM(seller_nmv) AS seller_nmv
     , SUM(seller_nmv_usd) AS seller_nmv_usd
     , MAX(order_be_status) AS order_be_status
     , SUM(IF(order_item_status IN ('OITEM_UNRATED','OITEM_RATED'), seller_gmv, 0)) AS order_escrow_item_seller_gmv
FROM mp_order.dwd_order_item_all_ent_df__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date >= date_sub(date('${grass_date}'), 90)
  AND grass_region = '${upper_region}'
  AND tz_type = 'local'
GROUP BY order_id
```

### 4. Organic order 时间桶分布 (organic_order_data_daily)

```sql
SELECT level1_global_be_category_id
     , CASE WHEN grass_region = 'SG' THEN create_timestamp + 8 * 3600
            WHEN grass_region = 'ID' THEN create_timestamp + 7 * 3600
            WHEN grass_region = 'BR' THEN create_timestamp - 3 * 3600
       END / 60 % 1440 AS min_bucket
     , COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt
     , grass_date, grass_region
FROM mp_order.dwd_order_item_all_ent_df__reg_s0_live a
WHERE grass_date = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND date(create_datetime) = date('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
  AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'SG', 'TH', 'PH', 'TW', 'MY', 'VN', 'BR')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 4, 5
```

### 5. 佣金费用聚合 (item_commission_stat_non_1p)

```sql
WITH order_raw AS (
    SELECT *, substr(create_datetime, 1, 10) AS local_create_date
    FROM mp_order.dwd_order_item_all_ent_df__reg_s0_live
    WHERE (grass_date = date '9999-01-01' OR grass_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', 27) AND date '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
      AND is_bi_excluded = 0
      AND coalesce(is_returned_item, 0) = 0
      AND coalesce(cancelled_qty, 0) = 0
)
SELECT item_id, shop_id
     , MAX(level1_global_be_category_id) AS level1_global_be_category_id
     , SUM(IF(local_create_date = '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', commission_base_amt_usd, 0)) AS commission_base_amt_usd_1d
     , SUM(IF(local_create_date >= date_sub('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}', 6), commission_fee_usd, 0)) AS commission_fee_usd_7d
FROM order_raw
GROUP BY item_id, shop_id, grass_region
```

### 6. 店铺评分统计 (rating_count_daily_reg)

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT shop_id, grass_region
     , COUNT(CASE WHEN lower(order_item_status) = 'oitem_rated' THEN order_id END) AS rating_count
FROM mp_order.dwd_order_item_all_ent_df__reg_s0_live
WHERE lower(order_fe_status) != 'cancelled'
  AND is_bi_excluded = 0
  AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'TH', 'PH', 'TW', 'VN', 'MY', 'SG', 'BR')
GROUP BY 1, 2
```

### 7. 无券自然单比例 (order_stats_wo_vouchers)

```sql
WITH global_prior AS (
    SELECT grass_region
         , SUM(CASE WHEN pv_promotion_id IS NULL AND sv_promotion_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
         / GREATEST(COUNT(1), 1.0) AS global_mu
    FROM mp_order.dwd_order_item_all_ent_df__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = date('2026-03-11')
    GROUP BY grass_region
)
SELECT u.grass_region, u.buyer_id AS user_id
     , COUNT(1) AS total_order_cnt_u
     , SUM(CASE WHEN pv_promotion_id IS NULL AND sv_promotion_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS org_order_cnt_u
     , (SUM(CASE WHEN pv_promotion_id IS NULL AND sv_promotion_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + g.global_mu * 10.0)
     / (COUNT(1) + 10.0) AS ratio_u
FROM mp_order.dwd_order_item_all_ent_df__reg_s0_live u
JOIN global_prior g ON u.grass_region = g.grass_region
WHERE u.grass_date = date('2026-03-11')
GROUP BY u.grass_region, u.buyer_id
```
